display_long_description:
Task Force 9 is a stealth-driven VR tactical shooter built around planning, positioning, and controlled execution. The optimal path is quiet: observe patrols, coordinate with your AI partner, isolate targets, and eliminate threats before they know you’re there.

Action is not removed—it is the consequence of failure or choice. When stealth breaks, the game allows aggressive recovery through breaching, explosives, rappelling, suppressive fire, and close-quarters combat. Combat is lethal, fast, and unforgiving. Charging in is possible, but never optimal.

Core gameplay focuses on:

Stealth-first level design with multiple infiltration routes

AI partner coordination and positioning

Environmental interaction: cover, verticality, wall breaches, ambush angles

High-risk CQB where mistakes compound immediately

Task Force 9 is not a power fantasy and not an arcade shooter. It rewards restraint, awareness, and disciplined decision-making. Action exists to resolve situations—not to replace planning.

This is a pre-release build. Systems, balance, and content are still evolving. Player feedback directly influences development and prioritization.

Community and support:

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/7a5QEhuvFz

YouTube (guides, hidden mechanics, development updates): https://www.youtube.com/@gooddaygamestudio

This pre-release version exists to support continued development and refinement toward a higher tactical standard.
